# v0.9.0b6 — One charging draft in HA and the app

- **Shared charging draft:** edit current, energy and finish time in Home Assistant
  or the app. Values persist; editing alone never starts charging.
- **Simple Mushroom dashboards:** ready-to-copy YAML in five languages, without
  extra helpers, scripts or a custom wallbox card.
- **Clearer documentation:** shorter installation and everyday-use guides, with
  dashboard examples easier to find.
- **Reliability fixes:** protect concurrent edits, preserve exact times across
  daylight-saving changes and avoid extra polling after invalid input.

## Before updating

Update the app to **0.9.0b6** first, then the integration. This integration
requires service **0.9.0b6 or newer**, API 2; versions still need not be identical.
